Italian Football Trophies Collection – Ultra Realistic 3D Pack features a premium selection of Italian-style league and competition trophies designed for sports broadcasts, game cinematics, promotional content, and presentation scenes. Each model is built with clean topology, realistic proportions, and high-quality metallic materials to ensure strong reflections and professional visual impact in both close-up renders and wide showcase environments.
This pack contains:

  - Serie A

  - Coppa Italia

  - SuperCoppa Italiana

  - Serie B

  - Serie C

  - Coppa Federale

These models are ideal for stadium scenes, sports branding visuals, award ceremonies, and football-themed projects requiring authentic Italian competition-style trophies. Perfect for game developers, motion designers, and 3D artists looking for realistic and production-ready football silverware assets.

description_text:
The life size version is split into multiple parts to fit 256X256 mm print beds.
 It doesn't fit in the A1 mini bed. It's split it three parts: base, statue and globe. 
There are no mid-statue seams as in other similar models.

AMs is not necessary. Manual filament changes supported via pre-inserted pause points.
 I recommend using PLA Silk filament and dropping printing speed to 50% to achieve smooth and glossy surface.
Glue recommended for final assembly of the life size version

description_text:
Description:
High-quality, detailed 3D model of the iconic Adidas Jabulani Official Match Ball, used during the 2010 FIFA World Cup in South Africa.
This model has been accurately crafted in Blender to match the unique 8-panel spherical geometry, seamless surface design, and vibrant traditional South African color accents of the original match ball. Perfect for photorealistic renders, sports visualizations, animations, commercial projects, and real-time game engines.
Key Features:Accurate Geometry: Clean and optimized mesh based on the real-world dimensions and iconic panel layout of the Jabulani ball.
High-Resolution Textures: Includes crisp, high-detail texture maps for close-up renders.
PBR Ready: Surface textures configured for realistic light reflections, subtle gloss, and leather-like roughness.
Game & Render Optimized: Well-balanced polycount suitable for smooth performance in Unreal Engine, Unity, and offline rendering (Cycles / Eevee / V-Ray).
Clean UV Unwrapping: Non-overlapping UV layout ensures no texture stretching or seams issues.
Included File Formats:.blend (Native Blender project file with materials applied)
.fbx (Universal 3D exchange format)
.obj + .mtl (Wavefront standard format)
.gltf / .glb (Ideal for web, AR, and real-time platforms)
Technical Specifications:Object Type: Soccer / Football Match Ball

description_text:
This 3D model was originally created with Sketchup 8 and then converted to all other 3D formats. Native format is .skp 3dsmax scene is 3ds Max 2016 version, rendered with Vray 3.00
The three residential highrises - 'Rudo' buildings or the Eastern gate of Belgrade are one of the most renowned buildings of the communist architecture in Yugoslavia. Built in 1976. on the hill, they mark the entrance to Belgrade from the Nis highway and the whole 'Konjarnik' residential neighborhood. With height of ~85m and 90m when looked from the lower level, they are among the tallest buildings in Belgrade and whole Balkans and with population of cca 500 each they are also among the most populated buildings in Balkans.

description_text:
Hey all! 
This is a clean mesh I've recently finished! It's fairly low poly looking despite having 40,000 + vertices, and is modeled after a real place (https://www.google.com/maps/@46.7868482,-92.0983326,3a,75y,287.7h,104.46t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sm38GZl6fGHhAXFB-80vNmA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192). This mesh can also be ported into other development environments. I've tried Cura, 3d paint, and Unity (as shown in the images). If you decide to import into Unity, know that the file labeled pixil-frame-1.png is your materials file. You should be able to click and drag it onto each object to color it. The pixil-frame-1.png is also my color palette that I used to model the buildings. I attached it separately so you can make more blender files with the same colors. if you choose to.
Thanks for checking out my project!

Cityscape Teaset

  - 16.6k polys.

  - Low-Poly, High-Quality Model.

  - Clean Geometry and Topology.

  - High-quality 4k textures (png). Includes:

  - Diffuse.

  - Roughness.

  - PBR shading.

  - Optimized to be rendered realistically in Cycles [ray-tracing] and Eevee [real-time].

  - Provided in:

  - AutoCAD FBX 2018 (.fbx),

  - Stanford (.ply), 

  - X3D Extensible 3D (.x3d),

  - Stl (.stl),

  - Alembic (.abc),

  - AutoCAD DXF 2018 (.dxf),

  - Universal Scene Description (.usdc),

  - Native Blender 3.1 file (.blend). 

Note: All Renders were done in Ray-tracing Cycles.

description_text:
1/1800th scale Suffren Class Cruiser model. Certain elements not to scale.
There were four Suffren-class heavy cruisers built by the French in the late '20's. They featured eight eight-inch guns as their primary armament, along with eight 3.5-inch guns, other smaller antiaircraft armament, and six torpedo tubes. Three were scuttled in 1942, with one being raised by the Italians and sunk by allied bombers in 1944. The lead-ship, Suffren, was not scuttled; instead it was disarmed and interned in Egypt in 1940 and brought back into service in 1943. It was scrapped in 1947.
This is part of my collection of WWII warships, keep an eye out for more to come. If you have a specific request, message me and I'll bump it up my list.
Update 29 Oct 19: Added boats and anchor chains. Adjustments for better printability.
Tested with PLA at .1mm layer height with .4mm nozzle.

description_text:
1/1800th scale Agano Class Cruiser model. Certain elements not to scale.
The Agano-class cruisers were a series of warships built for the Imperial Japanese Navy before WWII.  They carried six six-inch guns and eight torpedo tubes along with a collection of smaller armament.
This model is designed and tested at 1/1800th scale, but up-scaling and down-scaling are possible. Since the model is optimized for 1/1800th scale, it is not ideal to print larger versions due to a lack of detail. The gun barrels and mast have been enlarged
This is part of my collection of WWII warships, keep an eye out for more to come. If you have a specific request, message me and I'll bump it up my list.

Tested with PLA at .08mm layer height with .4mm nozzle.

description_text:
1/1800th scale Cruiser Oyodo model. Certain elements not to scale.
The light cruiser Oyodo was meant to be the lead ship of her class, but production was cancelled on the other ships. She carried six six-inch guns in two triple mounts and some smaller armament. She was sunk in July 1945.
This model is designed and tested at 1/1800th scale, but up-scaling and down-scaling are possible. Since the model is optimized for 1/1800th scale, it is not ideal to print larger versions due to a lack of detail. The gun barrels and mast have been enlarged.
This is part of my collection of WWII warships, keep an eye out for more to come. If you have a specific request, message me and I'll bump it up my list.
Update 07 Aug 19: Added boats and anchor chains. 
Tested with PLA at .08mm layer height with .4mm nozzle.

description_text:
1/1800th scale Perth Class Cruiser model. Certain elements not to scale.
The Perth class were the Amphion group of the Leander-class cruisers built and sold to the Australian Navy. Their primary armament were four twin six-inch guns and various secondary armament and torpedo tubes.
This is part of my collection of WWII warships, keep an eye out for more to come. If you have a specific request, message me and I'll bump it up my list.
Tested with PLA at .1mm layer height with .4mm nozzle.

HISTORICAL NOTE: HMS Agincourt was a battleship built in the United Kingdom in the early 1910s. Originally part of an order from the Brazilian government, it has the distinction of assembling more heavy cannons (fourteen) and more towers (seven) than any other battleship, dreadnought, according to the request of Brazilians.
Brazil ordered the ship in 1911 as Rio de Janeiro from the British company Armstrong Whitworth. However, the collapse of the rubber boom in Brazil, led to the sale of the ship under construction to the Ottoman Empire in 1913. The Ottomans renamed their name Sultan Osman I, in honor of the founder of the empire, and the ship was almost ready when World War I broke out. The British government seized it for use by the Royal Navy, along with another Ottoman battleship being built in Britain. Renamed Agincourt by the Royal Navy, she joined the Great Fleet in the North Sea. During the war, he participated in the Battle of Jutland in 1916. Agincourt was placed in reserve in 1919 and sold as scrap in 1922 to comply with the terms of the Washington Naval Treaty.
Additional note: The length of the ship and the huge number of 305mm cannons have always caused huge skepticism in the Royal Navy about the ship's ability to shoot sideways (with all cannons at the same time) without causing structural damage; these doubts were dispelled during the Battle of Jutland, during which the ship fired 144 shots, 84 of which against side fire, silencing its detractors. During this battle, the only one that saw her employed, the ship reported no damage and her crew did not report any deaths or injuries.

description_text:
The Capitolium or Capitoline Hill , between the Forum and the Campus Martius, is one of the Seven Hills of Rome.
The hill was earlier known as Mons Saturnius, dedicated to the god Saturn. The word Capitolium first meant the temple of Jupiter Optimus Maximus later built here, and afterwards it was used for the whole hill (and even other temples of Jupiter on other hills), thus Mons Capitolinus (the adjective noun of Capitolium). In an etiological myth, ancient sources connect the name to caput (head, summit) and the tale was that, when laying the foundations for the temple, the head of a man was found,[3] some sources even saying it was the head of some Tolus or Olus. The Capitolium was regarded by the Romans as indestructible, and was adopted as a symbol of eternity.
By the 16th century, Capitolinus had become Capitolino in Italian, and Capitolium Campidoglio. The Capitoline Hill contains few ancient ground-level ruins, as they are almost entirely covered up by Medieval and Renaissance palazzi (now housing the Capitoline Museums) that surround a piazza, a significant urban plan designed by Michelangelo.
The word Capitolium still lives in the English word capitol, and Capitol Hill in Washington, D.C. is widely assumed to be named after the Capitoline Hill.
Mixed photogrammetry and modeling

description_text:
This is the Mark I GP 250 lb bomb used by the Britain on multiple types of aircraft, from bombers to fighters, such as the Wellington or Typhoon. There are 6 different versions of the GP 250lb. It weighs 247 pounds, with an explosive mass of 68 pounds of T.N.T. or 63 pounds of Amatol 80/20. It has a diameter of 10.3 inches, and a total length of 54.2 inches. A bomb with a time delay fuse has red fins, and this model comes with textures for bombs with or without a time delay fuse.
The plugin used is Armory 3D, used to render the PBR images you see. The information in the description can be found in British Explosive Ordnance, published by Navy Department Bureau of Ordnance on June 10, 1946.

description_text:
https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belek_GaziBelek Gazi, (Balak ya da Balağ olarak da bilinir, tam adı Nürü'd-Devle Belek bin Behram bin Artuk, ö. 5 Mayıs 1124, Münbiç), Selçukluların Harput, Dersim, Halep ve Genc emiri olan Türkmen komutan. Bugün dahi adı hala Elâzığ'da sık sık anılarak yad edilen, dönemin Harput Emir'i ve Türk Orduları Başkumandanı'dır. Harput Türkmenlerinin, Gakgoşların atasıdır. Belek Gazi, Haçlılara karşı imha edici muharebelerle büyük zaferler kazanan, Anadolu'nun Türkleşmesinde büyük rol oynayan, kahramanlığı ile nam salmış, adil ve şefkatli bir Türk fatihiydi. Belek Gazi kendi döneminde gelişen Haçlı Seferlerine karşı büyük başarılar göstermiş, 1122 yılında Urfa kontu I. Joselin'i, 1123'te ise onu kurtarmaya gelen Kudüs Kralı II. Baudouin'i esir ederek zincire vurmuş ve ikisini de Harput kalesinde hapsetmiştir. Bu üstün başarıları üzerine Büyük Selçuk Sultanı tarafından Türk Orduları Başkumandanı tayin edilmiştir. Kendisine Gazi unvanı verilmiştir. Belek Gazi 1124 yılında ise Menbiç kalesini kuşatırken göğsüne isabet eden bir okla ölmüştür. Onun ölümü Müslümanların duraklamasına ve Haçlıların ise bir süre yükselişine sebep olsa da Belek Gazi'nin ölümünden 14 yıl sonra doğan, yine bir Selçuklu Emiri olan ve Haçlılara karşı büyük başarıları devam ettiren Selahattin Eyyubi çıkıvermiştir. Belek Gazi ile Selahattin Eyyubi yakın zamanlarda yaşadıklarından ve ikisi de Selçuklu Emirleri olduklarından ötürü dönemin ahalisi tarafından da sıkça mukayeseye tabii tutulmuşlardır.
Belek Gazi’den sonra 1185 yılına kadar Harput’ta yine Artukoğulları'ndan gelen Prensler, hüküm sürmüşlerdir. Bunlardan Fahrettin Kakmnj!raaslan’ında Harput tarihinde unutulmaz yeri ve eserleri vardır. 1148-1174 yılları arasında Harput’ta hüküm sürmüş ve burada bulunan Ulu Cami'yi yaptırmıştır. Tarihçi Profesör Halil Yinanç, Belek Gazi'den övgüyle bahsetmekte ve onun hakkında şunları demektedir: "Belek Gazi bütün ömrünü gaza ve cihad içinde geçirmiş, ülkesinde emsalsiz bir sükun ve asayiş temin etmiş, adalet ve kanunu hakim kılmış, dindar ve mütevazı bir emir idi. Ölümü, Müslümanlık ve Türklük için hakiki bir ziya ve musibet olmuş ve mağlup olmaya başlayan Haçlıların yeniden kalkınmalarına sebebiyet vermiştir. Haçlılar böyle korkunç ve galip bir düşmandan kurtuldukları için çok sevinmişlerdi.[

description_text:
A kettle hat, also known as a war hat, is a type of helmet made of iron or steel in the shape of a brimmed hat. There are many design variations. The only common element is a wide brim that afforded extra protection to the wearer. It gained its common English language name from its resemblance to a metal cooking pot (the original meaning of kettle). The kettle hat was common all over Medieval Europe. It was called Eisenhut in German and chapel de fer in French (both names mean iron hat in English)Historically accurate game ready asset modeled in Blender. High quality PBR material packed in just Diffuse/Metallic/Roughness/Normal_OpenGL textures available at 4k 2k and 1k resolution made in Substance Painter. Low Poly geometry. Obj, Fbx and .blend file. Buddha prayer beads bracelet means Harmony and Happiness. Dance with all different souls, and be ready to embrace more harmony and happiness. Buddha bead bracelet made of various natural stones and elements could help us recognize and respect differences in this universe.
gold
The colour of gold is important in the Buddhist mysticism. Laughing Buddha statues- symbolizing happiness and good health- are usually painted gold. Given its association with Sun, gold in Buddhism stands for knowledge, enlightenment, purity, happiness, and freedom.
Copper
Spiritual Properties
According to mythology, copper has the ability to conduct spiritual energy back and forth between individuals, crystals, auras, the mind and the spirit world. It is also used for its healing properties in improving circulation of blood, increasing energy and detoxification of the body.
Silver
Its faultless whiteness has made it a symbol of purity and of chastity. Purified in the refiner’s fire, it becomes a symbol of purification and perfection. Associated with its silvery counterpart in the night sky, it is integrated into an entire complex of lunar symbolism that includes the great purifier, water. Silver is representative of moon energy and is the balance between black and white. It is the color of the Greek goddess Artemis (Roman aspect: Diana). It is symbolic of purity, strength, clarity, focus, and the feminine energy.

Im re-selling these (actual real) Lanterns in my local town, so i decided to make a little model to have for advertising purposes (and as practice.)They are quite simple, no big deal. But, as i use to upload, it could be a nice space filler, or decoration, for a project. Also i haven't seen them on this plataform yet.As always, any constructive feedback is more than welcome.
Details:
Made with Blender 2.90.1 Rendered with Cycles. Last Picture in the Preview is the REAL LIFE reference for the model.

  - low-poly(1700 each piece)

  - Subdivition ready

  - 4sizes 

  - Different loose parts joined together (not a single continuous mesh)

  - The blend file comes with 4 procedural materials (cycles only) shown in the preview    -Rusty metal    -Metal    -Dusty shattered glass     -Glass

  - Formats: .Blend, .OBJ, .FBX, files

Admigual

description_text:
[USAGE] 

  - This model is suitable for use in Unity, Unreal Engine, Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Movies/Film, Interior/Exterior design, etc 

  - The model was originally modeled in Maya 2020 and rendered with Marmoset Toolbag 4

  - The model is accurate with the real world size and scale

[GENERAL]

  - PBR Materials

  - Game Ready model

  - Low Poly mesh

  - High Poly mesh baked on Low Poly mesh

  - Object pivot points at 0,0,0

  - Object scaled to approximate real world size (cm)

  - Object Height: 157cm

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied

  - Triangulate mesh and Quad both are included in folder

  - Texture Dimension 2048x2048, 4096x4096 and 8192x8192

[3D Model File Formats]

  - .Ma + .Mb + .Max

  - .3DS + .Fbx + .Obj + .dae + .Abc

  - .unitypackage + .uasset

  - .glTF + .glb + .USD + .USDZ

[GEOMETRY]

  - Polygons: 152

  - Tris: 296

  - Verts: 184

High resolution textures exported out of Substance Painter for PBR Metallic Roughness, Unreal Engine, Unity, Arnold, V-Ray, Spark AR Studio, Renderman, Redshift, KeyShot, Maxwell and more.
[TEXTURES]

  - Textures Formats: PNG

  - Includes 2 Set textures map(Clean, Dirty) with Texture Dimension 2048x2048, 4096x4096 and 8192x8192.

-------------(2K)----------------------

  - Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(2048x2048)

  - Base Color(2048x2048)

  - Metallic(2048x2048)

  - Roughness(2048x2048)

  - Ambient Occlusion(2048x2048)

-------------(4K)----------------------

  - Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(4096 x 4096)

  - Base Color(4096 x 4096)

  - Metallic(4096 x 4096)

  - Roughness(4096 x 4096)

  - Ambient Occlusion(4096 x 4096)

-------------(8K)----------------------

  - Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(8192x8192)

  - Base Color(8192x8192)

  - Metallic(8192x8192)

  - Roughness(8192x8192)

  - Ambient Occlusion(8192x8192)

[USAGE] 

  - This model is suitable for use in Unity, Unreal Engine, Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Movies/Film, Interior/Exterior design, etc 

  - The model was originally modeled in Maya 2020 and rendered with Marmoset Toolbag 4

  - The model is accurate with the real world size and scale

[GENERAL]

  - PBR Materials

  - Game Ready model

  - Low Poly mesh

  - High Poly mesh baked on Low Poly mesh

  - Object pivot points at 0,0,0

  - Object scaled to approximate real world size (cm)

  - Object Height: 240cm

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied

  - Triangulate mesh and Quad both are included in folder

  - Texture Dimension 2048x2048, 4096x4096 and 8192x8192

[3D Model File Formats]

  - .Ma + .Mb + .Max

  - .3DS + .Fbx + .Obj + .dae + .Abc

  - .unitypackage + .uasset

  - .glTF + .glb + .USD + .USDZ

[GEOMETRY]

  - Polygons: 124

  - Tris: 244

  - Verts: 146

High resolution textures exported out of Substance Painter for PBR Metallic Roughness, Unreal Engine, Unity, Arnold, V-Ray, Spark AR Studio, Renderman, Redshift, KeyShot, Maxwell and more.
[TEXTURES]

  - Textures Formats: PNG

  - Includes 2 Set textures map(Clean, Dirty) with Texture Dimension 2048x2048, 4096x4096 and 8192x8192.

-------------(2K)----------------------

  - Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(2048x2048)

  - Base Color(2048x2048)

  - Metallic(2048x2048)

  - Roughness(2048x2048)

  - Ambient Occlusion(2048x2048)

-------------(4K)----------------------

  - Base Color(4096 x 4096)

-------------(8K)----------------------

  - Base Color(8192x8192)

  - Metallic(8192x8192)

  - Roughness(8192x8192)

  - Ambient Occlusion(8192x8192)

[USAGE] 

  - This model is suitable for use in Unity, Unreal Engine, Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Movies/Film, Interior/Exterior design, etc

  - Game Ready model

  - Low Poly mesh

  - High Poly mesh baked on Low Poly mesh

  - Object pivot points at 0,0,0

  - Object scaled to approximate real world size (cm)

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied

  - Triangulate mesh and Quad both are included in folder

  - Texture Dimension 2048x2048, 4096x4096 and 8192x8192

[3D Model File Formats]

  - .Ma + .Mb + .Max

  - .3DS + .Fbx + .Obj + .dae + .Abc

  - .unitypackage + .uasset

  - .glTF + .glb + .USD + .USDZ

[GEOMETRY]

  - Tris: 244

description_text:
[USAGE] 

  - This model is suitable for use in Unity, Unreal Engine, Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Movies/Film, Interior/Exterior design, etc 

  - The model was originally modeled in Maya 2020 and rendered with Marmoset Toolbag 4

  - The model is accurate with the real world size and scale

[GENERAL]

  - PBR Materials

  - Game Ready model

  - Low Poly mesh

  - High Poly mesh baked on Low Poly mesh

  - Object pivot points at 0,0,0

  - Object scaled to approximate real world size (cm)

  - Object Height: 121cm

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied

  - Triangulate mesh and Quad both are included in folder

  - Texture Dimension 2048x2048, 4096x4096 and 8192x8192

[3D Model File Formats]

  - .Ma + .Mb + .Max

  - .3DS + .Fbx + .Obj + .dae + .Abc

  - .unitypackage + .uasset

  - .glTF + .glb + .USD + .USDZ

[GEOMETRY]

  - Polygons: 55

  - Tris: 110

  - Verts: 72

High resolution textures exported out of Substance Painter for PBR Metallic Roughness, Unreal Engine, Unity, Arnold, V-Ray, Spark AR Studio, Renderman, Redshift, KeyShot, Maxwell and more.
[TEXTURES]

  - Textures Formats: PNG

  - Includes 2 Set textures map(Clean, Dirty) with Texture Dimension 2048x2048, 4096x4096 and 8192x8192.

-------------(2K)----------------------

  - Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(2048x2048)

  - Base Color(2048x2048)

  - Metallic(2048x2048)

  - Roughness(2048x2048)

  - Ambient Occlusion(2048x2048)

-------------(4K)----------------------

  - Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(4096 x 4096)

  - Base Color(4096 x 4096)

  - Metallic(4096 x 4096)

  - Roughness(4096 x 4096)

  - Ambient Occlusion(4096 x 4096)

-------------(8K)----------------------

  - Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(8192x8192)

  - Base Color(8192x8192)

  - Metallic(8192x8192)

  - Roughness(8192x8192)

  - Ambient Occlusion(8192x8192)

description_text:
Concrete Barriers 
A Jersey barrier, Jersey wall, or Jersey bump is a modular concrete or plastic barrier employed to separate lanes of traffic. It is designed to minimize vehicle damage in cases of incidental contact while still preventing vehicle crossovers resulting in a likely head-on collision. Jersey barriers are also used to reroute traffic and protect pedestrians and workers during highway construction. They are named after the U.S. state of New Jersey which first started using the barriers as separators between lanes of a highway in the 1950s.
Features:

  - One model, 4 texture packs.

  - Clean topology and only quads.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

  - All objects have fully unwrapped UVs.

  - Preview renders were made in: Substain Painter and MarmosetToolbag.

  - All the objects of the model are named.

  - One UVW.

4xTextures:

  - Material Base Color, Height, Metallic, Mixed AO, Normal, Roughness.

  - Resolution: 4096x4096.

File Formats:
.max:

  - 3ds Max 2018 +Corona Render.

  - 3ds Max 2017 +Corona Render.

  - 3ds Max 2016 +Corona Render.

  - 3ds Max 2015 +Corona Render.

.obj:

  - OBJ for 3Ds max (MultiFormat).

  - OBJ for Blender (MultiFormat).

  - OBJ for C4D (MultiFormat).

  - OBJ for Maya (MultiFormat).

  - OBJ for ZBrush (MultiFormat).

Other:

  - 3DS.

  - Textures (.rar and .zip).

Polygons and Vertices:

  - Polygons: 204.

  - Vertices: 208.

description_text:
Hi friends,
here is my new project for WWII wargaming tables.It is a huge steel bridge in 28/35 mm scale. The bridge is nicely detailed and has sidewalks on the sides. For the surface, I recommend a layer of modeling compound and using a roller to shape the surface, for example.The size is 70 cm long, 35 cm wide and 15 cm high at the highest point.But don't worry, the bridge is divided into parts so that it can be printed on a 20x20cm printing surface.Printing is simple and completely support-free. The entire bridge is a large kit that is connected using M3 screws (the list of connecting material is part of the files).1 kg of filament was needed for printing, it depends on the settings. The bridge is really strong and can be used as a bridge.The bridge can be divided into two halves for portability and storage.When you go to play, you screw in 8 screws and you can play.I printed from PLA, but it's no problem to use PETG. The parts do not contain any supports or large bridging.Enjoy my work and liven up your gaming table with a really nice piece of terrain.
Have a nice day, Lukas

Overview: This model is a 3D representation of standard shipping pallets, ideal for enhancing realism in various 3D projects. The 3D model is based on EPAL euro pallets. Model made in Blender, textures made in Substance Designer and Substance Painter. Rendered in Blender using EEVEE and Cycles. The textures are packed into the .fbx and .glb files for seamless integration into your scenes.
Technical Specifications:
Software and Tools:

  - Model created in Blender

  - Textures generated in Substance Designer and Substance Painter

  - Rendering achieved using Blender's EEVEE and Cycles engines

  - Textures packed into .fbx and .glb files for seamless integration

File Formats:
  - .fbx, .glb, .obj, .stl, .blend
Textures:

  - Textures available in .jpg format

  - Resolution options: 8k, 4k, 2k, and 1k

Model Details:

  - Accurate representation of standard wooden pallets used in shipping and logistics.

  - Detailed surface textures mimic wood grain and imperfections.

  - Realistic wear and tear, including scratches, dents, and weathering effects.

Compatibility:

  - Compatible with leading 3D modeling and rendering software.

  - Suitable for use in various platforms and game engines.

Applications:

  - Gaming Environments: Create immersive gaming environments with authentic industrial structures.

  - Industrial Simulations: Simulate realistic industrial settings for training and educational purposes.

  - CGI Production: Incorporate realistic props into CGI scenes for film, animation, and virtual reality projects.

3D model of a Barrel bundle with PBR textures, ensuring high fidelity and realism. This low poly, game-ready asset has been designed with attention to detail, offering an optimal blend of quality and performance for various applications.

High-Quality Texturing: Textured meticulously in Substance Painter to achieve lifelike materials and surfaces.
Render Ready: All preview renders are generated in Unreal Engine, showcasing the model in a realistic setting.
Custom Branding: All branding and labels are custom-created, providing unique and distinct visual elements.
Inclusion: Model is provided as seen in renders, complete with all associated assets and textures.

Formats Included:
OBJ: Universal format compatible with most 3D software.
FBX: For seamless import into game engines and 3D software.
STL: Suitable for 3D printing applications.
Usage:This versatile model is suited for a wide range of applications, from gaming environments and personal projects to commercial productions. The asset can be integrated into any game engine or 3D project, enhancing the visual fidelity and immersion of your digital creations.
License Agreement:Upon purchase, you are granted the right to use this model in any game, personal project, or commercial product. Redistribution, resale, or repurposing of the model or its textures in any form is strictly prohibited, ensuring exclusivity for your project.
Support and Customization:We pride ourselves on customer satisfaction and are here to assist with any questions or support you may need. Customization requests, including texture adjustments or format conversions, are welcome to ensure the asset fits perfectly into your project.

description_text:
Stylized Cartoony Lighthouse 3d model made in 3ds Max 2022 and textured in Substance Painter. No plugins/addons were used.
Model details:

  - Every model part is named properly, model is centered to the middle of its bottom part and placed to 0.0.0 scene coordinates

  - Model has 9158 polygons and 9535 vertices

  - Lighthouse is unwrapped to a single 4k UV map, landscape is unwrapped to a different 4k UV map

  - Renders are made in Substance Painter Iray renderer, textures were rendered in 4k reso 

  - Model pack includes .fbx, .max, .obj, .blend files, textures are not embedded and have to be plugged in manually!

  - FBX files are provided for 2014/2015, 2016/2017 and 2020 versions

  - Textures pack includes Arnold, Corona, Unity hd and Vray .png 4k textures, as well as 4k .png, .jpeg and .targa UE4 textures

  - Railing connectors, ladder stairs and ladder sides share same UVs

  - Nothing is animated

  - Weighted normals are applied

  - You might want to rescale model

  - Building is hollow, there are no interiors

As usual - best wishes & have a nice day!

Low Poly model of a japanese Torii.
My insipiration was the Itsukushima shrine Torii.It was made using Blender, Substance Painter and Adobe Photoshop.
It’s gameready with roughly 3.6k triangles and 1.9k vertices.The maps are all PBR 4k (with an 8k AO): Normal, Base Color, Roughness, AO, Height and Metallic
If you enjoy this Model please some feedback in the comments!
A torii (Japanese: 鳥居, [to.ɾi.i]) is a traditional Japanese gate most commonly found at the entrance of or within a Shinto shrine, where it symbolically marks the transition from the mundane to the sacred.The presence of a torii at the entrance is usually the simplest way to identify Shinto shrines, and a small torii icon represents them on Japanese road maps.https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torii

description_text:
As seen in the Classic 1960's George Pal film The Time Machine, this is a model of the dedication monument with the inscribed plaquethat George reads when he arrives into London 1966.
This model has been designed to be printed in the following options:
Resin printed (as a single part)or in PLA (as two separate parts).  The model is hollowed out to help reduce the amount of material neeeded.
The model is scaled at 1/6th and can be reduced or enlarged to fit any size printer.  I have tested both the resin and PLA versions of the design and there have been no issues with either print.

description_text:
This listing is for the Large Version of the Love For Paris Light Up Diorama. The Mini version is also listed and a bundle for both is listed that saves you 25%.
File consists of:

  - 3 models; The Diorama Insert, Outer Shell, & Base. Each one comes in STL, OBJ, and FBX formats

  - Studio Quality Sample images

  - Buyer's Guide which has links to the lights that fit inside it (just little puck lights you twist to turn on. Nothing fancy.), the paint I used, and screws to use for the mini version.

The Large version is easily put together. Everything just slides together and you're done. Designed to be printed with Resin printers but can be printed with FDM printers as well, although I can't promise you'll get the same great details as you would with resin, like the top of the Eiffel Tower, small bushes, or Paris engraving on the front. For resin printers, everything has been designed where it doesn't need any supports if printed upright. Same might be possible with FDM printers because the overhangs are very small (Although the arch at the very top might need some). I print the diorama insert piece in clear resin and don't hollow it out. It's a solid piece. I found it looked better that way. Then I print the shell and base in white and spray paint them.
Dimensions when fully assembled:
Height: 127mm (5in)
Length: 101.6mm (4in)
Width: 101.6mm (4in)
Prior to me losing my ability to print, I was able to sell these at $25 for the minis and $70 for the larges.If you plan to sell these, feel free to use the studio quality sample pictures included for your listing :) And if you have any issues, you can shoot me an email at ForgedRealites@gmail.com

  -  SampleRoundLow  - 14x50x13 cm(5.5x19.6x5.1 inches)                         22    v           30 f              40 tr

  - 
SampleRoundHigh -  14x50x13 cm(5.5x19.6x5.1 inches)                        42    v           60 f              80 tr

Origin is at the world center and bottom center of each piece. Smaller, single pieces have an origin so they can lay flat on the ground. The blender file has textures packed. Previews are in-app (Blender) views, not renders. House in previews is for a sample use of one piece of the asset and is not included (Sold separately as my product). The last preview is a sample screenshot from Unreal Engine.UE Mannequin and scene are for scale and not included.All pieces are placed on a different layer in Blender. Exported as separate objects in other formats and archived.Textures include: 2048x2048 JPG format - Diffuse and Normalmap (Specularity and Displacement are included for convenience in the texture pack, but not used.)

Textures in formats other than .blend may have to be reassigned.If you want something else modeled, please contact me.

This small golden ball is the approximate size of a walnut and is part of the Quidditch sport created by J.K. Rowling. A Seeker catching the Snitch ends the game and scores the successful Seeker's team an additional 150 points.The Material chosen for developing this particular 3d model was brushed and polished gold. description_text:
By purchasing this pack, you’ll get access to 10 skyscraper / high-rise / tower buildings of mostly modern architectural style, a number of commercial / store signs and a simple system of indoor-wall-pieces that allow you to apply wallpaper and custom images on them, and place them inside shop windows wherever applicable; FBX included.
These buildings are not designed to replace complete, real buildings; they are, however, ideal gap fillers for your downtown, big-city scenario.
If you either choose to or have no other choice than to use them in the first line, some of the buildings come with a simple ground floor layout: pillars, some illumination, some wall trims etc. will be visible, so you can create a limited mockup of even interiors.
As we emphasize that this pack is pretty straightforward and not highly complex, we also want to point out that performance has been our secondary focus; polycounts are absolutely reasonable even for LOD0, but we have included LOD1 and LOD2 for the buildings as well in order to give you even more performance to work with.
To round things up, we have set up a material system that will allow you to modify colors for the building textures, which means you can theoretically create variations of your buildings to make them look more diverse.
This pack contains some CC0 content from Struffel aka Lennart Demes (textures, mostly floor / wall textures), Pixabay (mostly Concrete / Facade bits refined in Photoshop) and HDRI-Haven (HDRI-Background for Demo Level).

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 50
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 39
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl

Glass Roof:No

description_text:
pack of cigarettes glamour blue
A cigarette is a narrow cylinder of finely cut tobacco leaves that are rolled into thin paper for smoking. The cigarette is ignited at one end, causing the cigarette to smolder and allowing smoke to be inhaled from the other end, which is held in or to the mouth; in some cases, a cigarette holder may be used, as well. Most modern manufactured cigarettes are filtered, although this does not make them any safer. Cigarette manufacturers have described cigarettes as a drug administration system for the delivery of nicotine in acceptable and attractive form [1], [2], [3], [4]. Cigarettes are addictive (because of nicotine) and cause cancer, heart problems, and other health problems.
The term cigarette, as commonly used, refers to a tobacco cigarette but is sometimes used to refer to other substances, such as a cannabis cigarette. A cigarette is distinguished from a cigar by its usually smaller size, use of processed leaf, and paper wrapping, which is typically white. Cigar wrappers are typically composed of tobacco leaf or paper dipped in tobacco extract.
Rates of cigarette smoking vary widely throughout the world. Smoking rates have generally declined in the developed world, but continue to rise in developing nations.[5][6], [7]
Cigarettes carry serious health risks, which are more prevalent than with other tobacco products. Nicotine, a chemical in tobacco, which is used to manufacture cigarettes. Nicotine is the drug component of cigarettes and is very addictive.[8] About half of cigarette smokers die of tobacco-related disease[9] and lose on average 14 years of life.[8] Cigarette use by pregnant women has also been shown to cause birth defects, including low birth weight, fetal abnormalities, and premature birth.[10] Second-hand smoke from cigarettes causes many of the same health problems as smoking, including cancer, [11][12][13][14] which has led to legislation and policy that has prohibited smoking in many workplaces and public areas. Cigarette smokes contains over 7,000 chemical compounds, including arsenic, formaldehyde, cyanide, lead, nicotine, carbon monoxide, acrolein, and other poisonous substances.[15] Over 50 of these are carcinogenic.[16] Additionally, cigarettes are a frequent source fires leading to loss of lives in private homes, which prompted both the European Union and the United States to ban cigarettes that are not fire-standard compliant from 2011 onwards.

description_text:
The package contains 3D files for model printing - Sternwheeler Benjamim Guimarães. Note: Stylized model for easy printing.
The template contains the following file formats for printing: .stl, .obj, and .ply.
The size of the model is 160mm (16cm) x 30mm (3cm) x 65mm (6.5cm). Scale: 1:300.
Created in Blender 2.79b.
Verts - 2048
Faces - 2458
Tris - 4264
IIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIII
Historical Note: The Benjamim Guimarães is a steam paddle boat based in Pirapora, Minas Gerais, Brazil. It was built at Pittsburgh in the United States by James Rees and Company in 1913, one of a number of similar steamboats built for South American service. It originally navigated the rivers of the Amazon basin. In the 1920s the Benjamim Guimarães moved to the port of Pirapora on the Sao Francisco River.
Today, the Benjamim Guimarães is the only functioning steam paddle boat in all of Brazil. It is a tourist attraction and makes routine public trips on the São Francisco River from Pirapora downstream to the beginning of the Das Velhas River.
Benjamim Guimarães has three floors: in the first, there is the engine room, boiler, bathrooms and an area to house passengers. In the second, twelve cabins are installed and the third, a bar and covered area. It has capacity for 170 people, between crew and passengers and consumes one cubic meter of firewood per hour.
Dimensions:43.8 m long, 8 m mouth, 1.2 m tip, 9.25 m contour. Maximum and minimum draft: 1m and 0.6m.

description_text:
Love becomes a flower in this pendant necklace design, ready for 3Dprint and production.
WIKI
Origins of symbolHeart-shaped peepal leaves were used in artistic depictions of the Indus Valley Civilisation: a heart pendant originated from there has been discovered and is now exhibited in Delhi national museum.[citation needed] In the 6th-5th century BC, the heart shape was used to represent the heart-shaped fruit of the plant Silphium,[1] a plant possibly used as a contraceptive.[2] Many species in the parsley family have estrogenic properties, and some, such as wild carrot, were used to induce abortion.[3] Silver coins from Cyrene of the 6–5th BC bear a similar design, sometimes accompanied by a silphium plant and is understood to represent its seed or fruit.[4]
Earliest use
The earliest known possible visual depiction of a heart symbol, as a lover hands his heart to the beloved lady, in a manuscript of the Roman de la poire, mid-13th century.The combination of the heart shape and its use within the heart metaphor developed at the end of the Middle Ages, although the shape has been used in many ancient epigraphy monuments and texts. With possible early examples or direct predecessors in the 13th to 14th century, the familiar symbol of the heart represented love developed in the 15th century, and became popular in Europe during the 16th.[5] Before the 14th century, the heart shape was not associated with the meaning of the heart metaphor. The geometric shape itself is found in much earlier sources, but in such instances does not depict a heart, but typically foliage: in examples from antiquity fig leaves, and in medieval iconography and heraldry typically the leaves of ivy and of the water-lily. One possible early use in the 11th century could be found in the manuscript, Al-Maqamat written by Al Hariri of Basra. The manuscript includes an illustration of a farewell greeting between two men while astride their camels, with the heart shape seen prominently over their heads.[6][not in citations given]
The first known depiction of a heart as a symbol of romantic love dates to the 1250s. It occurs in a miniature decorating a capital 'S' in a manuscript of the French Roman de la poire (National Library FR MS. 2086, plate 12). In the miniature a kneeling lover (or more precisely, an allegory of the lover's sweet gaze or douz regart) offers his heart to a damsel. The heart here resembles a pine cone (held upside down, the point facing upward), in accord with medieval anatomical descriptions. However, in this miniature what suggests a heart shape is only the result of a lover's finger superimposed on an object; the full shape outline of the object is partly hidden, and therefore unknown. Moreover, the French title of the manuscript that features the miniature translates into Novel Of The Pear in English. Thus the heart shaped object would be a pear; the conclusion that a pear represents a heart is dubious. Opinions therefore differ over this being the first depiction of a heart as symbol of romantic love.[7] Giotto in his 1305 painting in the Scrovegni Chapel (Padua) shows an allegory of charity (caritas) handing her heart to Jesus Christ. This heart is also depicted in the pine cone shape based on anatomical descriptions of the day (still held upside down). Giotto's painting exerted considerable influence on later painters, and the motive of Caritas offering a heart is shown by Taddeo Gaddi in Santa Croce, by Andrea Pisano on the bronze door of the south porch of the Baptisterium in Florence (c. 1337), by Ambrogio Lorenzetti in the Palazzo Publico in Siena (c. 1340) and by Andrea da Firenze in Santa Maria Novella in Florence (c. 1365). The convention of showing the heart point upward switches in the late 14th century and becomes rare in the first half of the 15th century.[7]
The scalloped shape of the now-familiar heart symbol, with a dent in its base, arises in the early 14th century, at first only lightly dented, as in the miniatures in Francesco Barberino's Documenti d'amore (before 1320). A slightly later example with a more pronounced dent is found in a manuscript from the Cistercian monastery in Brussels (MS 4459–70, fol 192v. Royal Library of Belgium). The convention of showing a dent at the base of the heart thus spread at about the same time as the convention of showing the heart with its point downward.[8] The modern indented red heart has been used on playing cards since the late 15th century.[9]
Various hypotheses attempted to connect the heart shape as it evolved in the Late Middle Ages with instances of the geometric shape in antiquity.[10] Such theories are modern, proposed from the 1960s onward, and they remain speculative, as no continuity between the supposed ancient predecessors and the late medieval tradition can be shown. Specific suggestions include: the shape of the seed of the silphium plant, used in ancient times as a(n) herbal contraceptive,[10][11] and stylized depictions of features of the human female body, such as the female's breasts, buttocks, pubic mound, or spread vulva.[12]

description_text:
High-quality low-poly model of Outdoor Trash Can.
It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
Model is built with great attention to details and realistic proportions with correct geometry.
Textures are very detailed so it makes this model good enough for close-ups. 
Technical details:

  - 1024 x 1024 Diffuse and AO textures

  - 292 Triangles

  - 162 Polygons

  - 220 Vertices

  - Model is one mesh.

  - Model completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot point centered at world origin.

  - Model scaled to approximate real world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials and textures are appropriately named.

Available file formats:

  - 3ds Max 2016 (.max)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - Blender 2.82 (.blend | Cycles)

  - Unity3d 2017.3 (.unitypackage)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.glb)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

Follow Me!

Twitter: https://twitter.com/rescue3dassets
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/user/Rescue3DAssets
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rescue3dassets
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCCKuB8qTeRtiX0vye9qverw/
Website: https://www.rescue3d.com  
Additional Info:

  - To avoid misunderstandings this model is not intended for 3D printing.
It uses some low/mid-poly modeling tricks and is optimized for real-time and gaming apps and is an open mesh.
It is also intended primarily for rendering using various rendering engines (as Blender Cycles or Vray).

  - If you like this model and would like to make it printable please contact me first.
I'll try to make the model printable but I'll et you know if it is at all possible and what the differences will be.

I'll try try to reply as soon as possible and help you clear up any doubts. I can also send you some additional screenshots if you need.

description_text:
Retro rusty traffic lights 3D asset - game-ready - highpoly on lowpoly - modeled with Blender 2.80, textured carefully with Substance Painer.Rendered with Eevee (also with different HDRIs). 2 parented mesh objects, single material. UV mapped for most optimal use of UV space. Metric units. 
LODSLOD0:Verts: 1,214 Tris: 2,142LOD1: Verts: 942 Tris: 1,666LOD2:Verts: 655 Tris: 1,124LOD3:Verts: 346 Tris: 603LOD4: Verts: 191 Tris: 316You can find LODs in separate archives in fbx. and obj. format.
Textures2K Textures in 3 different formats. PBR metallic roughness: BaseColor, AO, Metallic, Roughness, Normal, Height. Unity 5: AlbedoTransparency, AO, MetallicSmoothness, Normal, EmissionUnreal Engine 4: BaseColor, Normal, Emission, OcclussionRoughnessMetallic
AttentionPlease note that blend., fbx., obj., stl. files contains only clear mesh model without textures. Textures are stored in a separate ZIP archives and have to be manually applied.

If you have any questions fell free to contact me before purchasing.
Waiting Room Seat V2 1 Big Seat

  - This 3D model was made in Rhinoceros 6.0 and rendered on Keyshot 6.

  - Rhinoceros is a CAD Software (Surfaces and Solids not meshes, as demonstrated on the printscreens) when converted to mesh they become triangles not quads.

  - If you are going to use on a different software I highly recommend that you download few of my free 3D models and test if they work well with your 3D software before making a purchase.

  - The model is very detailed, great for detailed scenes and close-up renders.

  - There is no Edges/Opens Surfaces. All the parts of the model are Solid.

  - Previews of the products included.

If you have any problem with the 3D Model, feel free to contact me and i'll make it right! Thank you for your support!

Flaviker, a historic Italian ceramic tile brand set up in the Emilia region in the late 1960s, produces indoor and outdoor full-body porcelain tiles for architectural applications.
Following its acquisition by ABK GROUP in 2007, it changed direction and focused in particular on design and technological innovation.
Flaviker combines contemporary characteristics with a sophisticated and minimalist aesthetic while remaining constantly attentive to the latest trends.
A world-famous Italian ceramic producer, Flaviker is renowned for its quality, innovation, eco-sustainability and constantly evolving style. It specialises in contemporary porcelain surfaces, delivering high-performance products with cutting-edge aesthetics and technology in a constantly expanding range of sizes and finishes. Drawing from multiple inspirations, the sheer breadth of its range makes it particularly suitable for complete residential and public projects. Its architectural surfaces reproduce an array of different materials including concrete, stone, marble and plain colours and are ideal for use both as individual wall coverings and as mix-and-match solutions for a total crossover effect.
Each individual collection becomes a highly versatile tool in the hands of an architect, bringing a distinctive look to residential projects and public and commercial spaces. Utilising the manufacturing expertise acquired throughout its history, Flaviker combines aesthetic excellence with technological innovation to offer sizes ranging from large tiles to flexible ceramic planks and extra-thick slabs for outdoor use.

This is a 3d model of a garden bench. High quality and ready for close plans.  Floor is included.Perfect geometry. Perfect UV unwrapping for texture placement. High quality PRB textures. Set up for render in V-Ray.
############################################
|GEOMETRY|
Perfect topology. Please check the wireframe preview images. No tris, all quad polygons.
############################################
|UV MAPPING|
The model is perfectly unwrapped. Please check the preview images for examples and uvguides. 
############################################
|TEXTURES|
The model is fully textured. Texture size is 4096x4096 pixels. PNG file format. 
############################################
|FILE FORMATS|
Autodesk 3ds max
3ds max 2018, V-Ray 5. Everything is set up for render. What you see on the preview renders is what you get.
############################################
Maxon Cinema 4D
Cinema 4d R19. Everything is set up for Physical render. Textures baked out of 3ds max. Check the preview images for an example.
############################################
|Other formats|
fbx, 3ds, obj, lwo, abc, dae, lxo. Exported formats with textures included and applied. However, in some softwares additional tweaking or texture reassigning may be required depending on the case.

description_text:
Pivoting Public Seating  
The public seating system is a compelling study due to the versatility that it might embody to make it optimally practical. The Fan Bench by Wang Chunyu is a clever concept that was born from thinking outside of the box.
The designer would not be content to have his multi-person perch strictly positioned in a small designated area of a floor or an outdoor plaza. This arrangement would allow for zero adaptability should the program of that space change, even temporarily.
An ingenious solution was conceived that bases the long backless chair around a fixed anchor. Not one, but three separate fins can rotate around this axis, instantly offering three times the seating by necessity. The Fan Bench by Wang Chunyu would be brilliant for installation in art galleries and museums.

Banc public contemporain FORMA
The combination of wood and concrete is timeless in design. The bench of simple, clean shapes, benefiting from a combination of wooden slats and solid supports made of high-quality concrete, perfectly follows its function. Curved versions without backrests and wall-mounted versions allow you to create exciting assemblies. description_text:
Boardwalk Bench 
1 948 poly
This modern bench, inspired by its origins, features FSC Recycled reclaimed Cumaru hardwood, repurposed from the actual slats of the Atlantic City Boardwalk.
The bench’s design makes the most of the Atlantic City hardwood, using smaller wood slats in a unique, asymmetrical pattern. This has allowed us to salvage as much of the wood as possible, while also cutting out imperfections like knots and bolt holes.  The bench tells its own story, by preserving the boardwalk aesthetic while still offering a fresh, innovative design.
At Forms+Surfaces, our design philosophy is deeply tied to our commitment to environmental responsibility. We were thrilled to be able to procure this historic FSC Recycled reclaimed Cumaru, which offers superior resistance to moisture, insects, fire, vandalism and decay, without the need to cut down a single tree.
This bench truly has it all: an eye-catching design, high durability, a great environmental story and a tie to the past. 
And while the slats are a highlight of this bench, every detail has been thoroughly considered. Note the cast aluminum ends which are contoured with a chevron shape at the top and taper down to a flat plane at the bottom. The ends also are slightly slanted inwards, adding to the angular feel of the piece.
This elegant, backless 6-foot bench will work equally well in indoor and outdoor settings. In addition to boardwalks, waterfronts and parks, the Boardwalk Bench would be ideal in corporate, healthcare and hospitality settings, as well as convention centers, stadiums and shopping centers or other retail outlets.

Flaviker, a historic Italian ceramic tile brand set up in the Emilia region in the late 1960s, produces indoor and outdoor full-body porcelain tiles for architectural applications.
Following its acquisition by ABK GROUP in 2007, it changed direction and focused in particular on design and technological innovation.
Flaviker combines contemporary characteristics with a sophisticated and minimalist aesthetic while remaining constantly attentive to the latest trends.
A world-famous Italian ceramic producer, Flaviker is renowned for its quality, innovation, eco-sustainability and constantly evolving style. It specialises in contemporary porcelain surfaces, delivering high-performance products with cutting-edge aesthetics and technology in a constantly expanding range of sizes and finishes. Drawing from multiple inspirations, the sheer breadth of its range makes it particularly suitable for complete residential and public projects. Its architectural surfaces reproduce an array of different materials including concrete, stone, marble and plain colours and are ideal for use both as individual wall coverings and as mix-and-match solutions for a total crossover effect.
Each individual collection becomes a highly versatile tool in the hands of an architect, bringing a distinctive look to residential projects and public and commercial spaces. Utilising the manufacturing expertise acquired throughout its history, Flaviker combines aesthetic excellence with technological innovation to offer sizes ranging from large tiles to flexible ceramic planks and extra-thick slabs for outdoor use.

Flaviker, a historic Italian ceramic tile brand set up in the Emilia region in the late 1960s, produces indoor and outdoor full-body porcelain tiles for architectural applications.
Following its acquisition by ABK GROUP in 2007, it changed direction and focused in particular on design and technological innovation.
Flaviker combines contemporary characteristics with a sophisticated and minimalist aesthetic while remaining constantly attentive to the latest trends.
A world-famous Italian ceramic producer, Flaviker is renowned for its quality, innovation, eco-sustainability and constantly evolving style. It specialises in contemporary porcelain surfaces, delivering high-performance products with cutting-edge aesthetics and technology in a constantly expanding range of sizes and finishes. Drawing from multiple inspirations, the sheer breadth of its range makes it particularly suitable for complete residential and public projects. Its architectural surfaces reproduce an array of different materials including concrete, stone, marble and plain colours and are ideal for use both as individual wall coverings and as mix-and-match solutions for a total crossover effect.
Each individual collection becomes a highly versatile tool in the hands of an architect, bringing a distinctive look to residential projects and public and commercial spaces. Utilising the manufacturing expertise acquired throughout its history, Flaviker combines aesthetic excellence with technological innovation to offer sizes ranging from large tiles to flexible ceramic planks and extra-thick slabs for outdoor use.

description_text:
Park bench scene made in 3ds Max 2022 and textured in Substance Painter. Full scene has 3570 polygons and 3457 vertices. 
Scene consists of 3 models:

  - 
Bench. A set of 2k textures, separate .fbx/.max/.blend/.obj files centered to 0.0.0 scene coordinates. 2016 polygons, 1958 vertices. Side metal elements share same UVs (overlapping texture)

  - 
Lantern. A set of 2k textures, separate .fbx/.max/.blend/.obj files centered to 0.0.0 scene coordinates. 996 polygons, 956 vertices. Nothing is overlapping. Unlit textures can be seen in screenshot section

  - 
Garbage bin. A set of 2k textures, separate .fbx/.max/.blend/.obj files centered to 0.0.0 scene coordinates. 522 polygons, 506 vertices. Nothing is overlapping

Scene details

  - Model pack contains .fbx / .max / .blend and .obj file formats. Textures aren’t embedded into each format and have to be plugged in manually. Fbx files are provided for 2014/2015, 2016/2017 and 2020 versions.

  - You might want to rescale the model to match scene size

  - Model is centered to the middle of its bottom part and placed to 0.0.0 scene coordinates

  - Textures come in 2k resolution

  - Texture pack contains .png textures optimized for Arnold, Vray, Corona, UnityHDmetal + .png/.jpeg and .targa files optimized for UE4

  - Nothing is animated

  - UV maps can be seen in screenshots section

  - Everything is named properly

  - Renders were made in SP Iray renderer

Make sure to contact me if you want more details or some minor adaptations to the model.
As usual: best wishes and have a nice day!:D

Modular Urban Wall Pack with photorealistic AAA quality, yet surprisingly optimised!
ONLY THE WALL MODULES ARE INCLUDED. The rest of the props (streets, streetlights, trims, pillars, trees, etc.) are only for showcase purposes and not included in this pack. The wall modules are also not assembled into full buildings, but are provided as separate pieces for you to easily assemble.
This pack was designed to be of photorealistic, AAA quality, in order to pack lots of immersion into your 3D world.
The walls are well-detailed, with graffiti, posters, wear, pipes, cables, etc.

  - 11 wall modules

  - Modular and easy to snap together

  - UV-unwrapped, with materials assigned

  - Textures are organised well into folders and named clearly

  - Low Poly (322 tris on average)

  - All wall modules have 4K PBR textures (Albedo, Normal, Metalness, Roughness, Ambient Occlusion, Mask)

  - Textures are easy to edit (since they have been kept intact)

They are suitable for populating:

  - Modern industrial streets and alleys

  - Dystopian rundown areas in a cyberpunk world

Included wall modules:

  - Wall01 - 272 tris

  - Wall03 - 180 tris

  - Wall05 - 485 tris

  - Wall06 - 286 tris

  - Wall07 - 363 tris

  - Wall08 - 315 tris

  - Wall09 - 96 tris

  - Wall10 - 608 tris

  - Wall11 - 430 tris

  - Wall12 - 436 tris

  - Wall13 - 47 tris

Note that Wall02 and Wall04 have been skipped on purpose.
(Some walls are based on real-life photos I took, while some are based on AI-generated images)
Unity Package supports HDRP only.
======================================
Technical Details

  - 11 wall modules

  - No other props depicted in the images (streets, streetlights, trims, pillars, trees, etc.) are included

  - 4K PBR textures (Albedo, Normal, Metalness, Roughness, Ambient Occlusion, Mask)

  - UV-unwrapped, with materials assigned

  - Textures are organised well into folders and named clearly

  - Low Poly (47-608 tris per wall module, 320 tris on average)

  - Easy to snap together

  - Textures are easy to edit (since they have been kept intact)

  - No interiors or back-sides

  - No LODs or colliders
